card.title: PlayStation 5 Not turning on repair

claims.statement: PS5 no power: check 12 V from the PSU; check shorts behind southbridge CXD90061GG (not married, replaceable).
On a 12 V bench supply with no ~300 mA boot step, remove the BIOS IC for 10–20 minutes, resolder and retry; else reprogram with a working digital BIOS (disc drive will no longer work).

procedure: Measure 12 V at the PSU connector.
Bench-feed 12 V and watch for ~300 mA step.
Remove/reseat BIOS IC; reflash with digital BIOS if needed.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
